description: Source code implementing UDP communication for an echo client in Zephyr RTOS, including socket management, threading, and signal handling.

methods.name: send_udp_data
methods.description: Sends UDP data, generating random payload size and initiating receive timer.

methods.name: wait_reply
methods.description: Handles timeout waiting for UDP reply, signals to retransmit.

methods.name: wait_transmit
methods.description: Signals to proceed with next UDP transmission.

methods.name: start_udp_proto
methods.description: Creates and connects UDP socket, optionally with TLS settings.

methods.name: process_udp_proto
methods.description: Receives and validates UDP data, manages timers and signals.
